subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about completed-order acquisition in UK food delivery. Since Just Eat began running its own delivery fleet under pressure from Deliveroo and Uber Eats, the cost of every first order matters more, and UK Food and Drink ecommerce CPA now sits near 3.95 percent of revenue on a £127 average order as of May 2026. That is exactly where a completed-order, holdout-measured model decides your real cost per incremental order. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: Just Eat in-house delivery shift (sourced) + UK food and drink ecommerce CPA band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN food_and_delivery CPS: acknowledges second follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely development (Just Eat running its own delivery service under Deliveroo/Uber Eats pressure) + sourced UK Food & Drink ecommerce CPA 3.95% of revenue and £127 AOV, May 2026 (IRP Commerce, retrieved and confirmed); MobUpps holdout/incrementality reference with no figure; brands only from candidate set (Just Eat, Deliveroo, Uber Eats); 1 question mark; native UK business English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y.
